definitions.en: To solve the problem is another way of finding the answer. To find out what 2 + 3 is, you have to add. Adding is how you solve the problem.
definitions.es: Resolver el problema es otra manera de encontrar la respuesta. Para saber cuánto es 2 + 3, usted tiene que sumar. Sumar es la forma de resolver el problema.

practice.prompt: Tyler mows lawns on the weekend for $15 per lawn. Tyler wants to know how much he made last month. He mowed 6 lawns. He had to pay $4 for gas. How much money did Tyler make last month after expenses?

help.text: You can use multiplication to solve this problem. Multiply the number of lawns mowed by the amount Tyler earns per lawn. Then subtract the amount Tyler had to pay for gas.
help.example: Example: Gerald earned $25 a day washing cars. He washed cars for 5 days last month. He also had to pay $15 for cleaning supplies. How much money did Gerald make last month after expenses?
help.productAdaptation: Pause playback and gate the four answer controls while Help or its glossary is open; restore the same retry state on close.

practice.wrongText: You can use multiplication and subtraction to solve this problem.  Multiply the number of lawns mowed by the amount Tyler earns per lawn. Then subtract the amount Tyler had to pay for gas.
